products.notes: 12 highlevel in (5-32 V) + 6 pre in (1.3-9 V) + AUX (0.7-5 V) + 2 optical S/PDIF (max 192k/24). 13 pre outs in IIR mode (9 in FIR mode) + AD Link digital outs. Output EQ: 13 parametric bands/ch in IIR mode (FIR mode: 9 FIR + 3 IIR), +12/-15 dB; Main EQ 5 FIR + 1 IIR. Delay 0-22 ms, 0.04 ms step. SNR 105 dBA (master in) / 110 (AUX) / 104 (optical). 96 kHz floating point. PC software: 'bit One HD Virtuoso' (download bit_One_HD_Virtuoso-3_1_0_0.zip on product page).

4 highlevel in (FL/FR/RL/RR) + phone in + AUX (0.6-5 V). 5 pre outs (front L/R, rear L/R, sub). Output EQ: 31-band 1/3-oct GRAPHIC +/-12 dB (not parametric). Delay 0-15 ms, 0.08 ms step. 48 kHz fixed point. SNR 96 dBA. PC software 'bit Ten' (bit_Ten-1_2_2_0.zip).

Retailer copy of Audison spec (bit Nove / bit Nove DRC, code BITNOVED). 6 pre in (1.3-9 Vrms) + 6 high-level in (5-32 Vrms) + AUX (0.7-5 Vrms) + 2 optical S/PDIF (max 192k/24); 9 RCA outs. Output EQ: 10-pole parametric per channel, +/-12 dB, 20 Hz-20 kHz; automatic de-equalization on inputs. Crossover LR 12/24, BW 6/12/18/24 dB/oct, 68 steps. Time alignment 0-15 ms (0.08 ms step, 0.02 ms fine). Max output 4 V @0.1% THD. SNR 104 dBA pre / 105 AUX / 110 optical. Retailer page also carries some bit One HD-style rows (13 IIR outs) - output count beyond 9 unconfirmed. Internal sample rate not stated. Windows PC software via micro-USB.

Retailer copy of Audison spec. Inputs: 4 high-level (2-15 Vrms) + PHONE + AUX (0.6-5 Vrms) + optical S/PDIF (max 96k/24). Outputs: 5 analog pre outs (front L/R, rear L/R, sub) + AD Link digital out (8 ch S/PDIF). EQ: 31-band graphic per output channel, +/-12 dB, 1/3 oct (not parametric); automatic de-EQ on high-level inputs. Delay 0-15 ms (0-510 cm), 0.08 ms step, 0.02 fine. Crossover LR 12/24, BW 6/12/18/24, 68 steps. Max output 4 Vrms @0.1% THD. SNR 105 dBA digital / 95 dBA master & AUX. PCM 48 kHz, 24-bit AD/DA. PC software 'bit Ten' (Standard/Expert). Discontinued.
